name: carbon-theme
description: Carbon and Min color themes bundled with matching Flow file icon themes and Carbon product icons.

scripts.check: npm run check:icons && npm run validate
scripts.package: npm run check && mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository --no-rewrite-relative-links --out dist/carbon-theme-$npm_package_version.vsix

carbonTheme.autoApplyIcons.markdownDescription: Automatically select the matching file icon theme (Carbon Icons Deep for dark themes, Carbon Icons Dawn for light themes) when a Carbon or Min color theme is active. Icon themes chosen by the user are left untouched.

carbonTheme.autoApplyProductIcons.markdownDescription: Automatically select the matching product icon theme (Carbon Solid for dark themes, Carbon Outline for light themes) when a Carbon or Min color theme is active. Product icon themes chosen by the user are left untouched.

carbonTheme.hidesExplorerArrows.markdownDescription: Hide the explorer's folder arrows in the Carbon Icons file icon themes. The active theme file is rewritten and reloaded automatically.

carbonTheme.hidesExplorerFolders.markdownDescription: Hide folder icons in the Carbon Icons file icon themes, including name-specific folder icons. The workspace root keeps its icon.
